name: Somatropin

lead: Somatropin is recombinant human growth hormone, identical in sequence to the pituitary hormone. It is a prescription medicine for children and adults with growth hormone deficiency and several other conditions.

It is also used illicitly for body composition and anti-aging. Evidence is strong in deficiency; in healthy people studies report it can add some lean mass, with limited strength benefit and notable side effects.

paras: It binds growth hormone receptors and activates JAK2/STAT signalling, which prompts the liver and other tissues to produce IGF-1. The result is growth, fat mobilization and effects on glucose metabolism and fluid balance.

Somatropin is prescription-only and banned in sport. Side effects include fluid retention, joint pain, carpal tunnel syndrome and insulin resistance. Chronic excess causes acromegaly, with enlargement of the jaw, brow and hands, plus heart and metabolic problems and a possible cancer link. This is informational, not guidance for use.
